Title: HPC Specialized VMs - HB and HC-series

Body.Content:
We are pleased to announce we are deploying HB and HC Virtual Machines to additional regions

  • The HB-Series VM is now available in East US.
  • The HC-Series VM is now available in Japan East.

The HB-series VMs are optimized for HPC applications driven by memory bandwidth, such as fluid dynamics, explicit finite element analysis, and weather modeling.

HC-series VMs are optimized for HPC applications driven by intensive computation, such as implicit finite element analysis, reservoir simulation, and computational chemistry. 

See regional availability for Azure Virtual Machines here.

Learn more
